opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering high‑quality fine and performing arts training for school‑age children under 18; institutions may apply once per round; individual scholars/students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Supports specialist arts institutions to provide training opportunities (weekends, evenings, holidays) for school‑age children in fine and performing arts.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities offering undergraduate/postgraduate fine and performing arts programmes; institutions may apply once per round; individual students cannot apply directly.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries (£5,000‑£10,000 per year) to support outstanding undergraduate or postgraduate arts students in financial need.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one; up to £28,000 in years two and three (salary contribution); up to £6,000 per year research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate; must have submitted doctoral thesis for viva by closing date; UK residency; UK university appointment or degree.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research over a three‑year fellowship.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers residing in the UK; must have held a teaching/research post at a UK university or eligible research institute; must be research‑active; institution must approve.
opportunities.summary: Provides short‑term fellowships (3‑24 months) for emeritus researchers to complete or finalise a research project.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million total (up to 30 scholarships per award)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two universities); applications made by the lead university; scholarships for doctoral students (including under‑represented groups) and limited post‑doctoral opportunities.
opportunities.summary: Centenary doctoral scholarships providing up to four‑year funded doctoral places (including tuition, maintenance and research costs) and additional support for cohort‑building and post‑doctoral activities.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (with research degree‑awarding powers) – single or collaborative centres; one application per university as lead; international partners welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship over up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: salary contribution up to £56,000 in year one; up to £28,000 in years two and three; research expenses up to £6,000 per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established, distinguished researchers in humanities or social sciences; must be employed at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers; cannot have previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ to three‑year fellowships enabling senior researchers to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with international impact; must hold a permanent post or long‑term fellowship at a UK university; doctorate awarded ≤10 years before closing date (career‑break exceptions apply).
opportunities.summary: Awards individuals for outstanding early‑career research across rotating subject areas.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed at UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers; must be resident in the UK; must demonstrate that teaching/administrative duties have significantly impacted research in the previous three years.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £70,000 to support experienced researchers (including replacement costs) for a 3‑24 month fellowship.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: up to £1 million (staff salaries and associated costs) for 4‑5 year award

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK university appointment (or nominated); must not have previously led a research team or held a comparable award.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead modest research teams to tackle distinctive research problems.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and eligible independent research institutes on a trial basis); principal investigator must be employed at the institution; at least 75 % of budget for research staff; projects up to five years.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative, original research projects across all disciplines (excluding medical/clinical, policy‑driven, commercial‑application, data‑bank focused research).

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) coordinating the visit; host institution must approve; visitor must be eminent senior professor from overseas; previous holders must wait 7 years.
opportunities.summary: Funds 3‑12 month visits by eminent overseas scholars to enhance UK research capacity and skills in under‑represented areas.
